newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's Santos benefits from 24-hour operations.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's Santos benefits from 24-hour operations.

text.p: The move to 24-hour operations at Brazil's key port of Santos has seen positive results in its first month, the CODESP port authority said in a statement.

In an analysis of movements at the port's public terminals during July, CODESP said 310 ships had been turned around, a record for the month, a 9.9 percent increase on June and a 6.2 percent rise on July 1996. In terms of tonnage, the public terminals handled 2.63 million tonnes, up 13 percent from the same month last year and a rise of 18 percent on June 1997.
One of the star performers during July was bulk sugar which in one month saw exports of 150,000 tonnes, more than twice the 67,756 tonnes shipped in the same month last year.
